evidence: Running the augmentation stack from the Oxford Pets segmentation example inside Docker (python:3.10-slim-bookworm, tensorflow==2.13.1, keras-cv==0.6.1, keras-core==0.1.5) fails while tracing tf.data.Dataset.map(...). The error is: TypeError: branches[0] and branches[1] arguments to tf.switch_case must have the same number, type, and overall structure of return values; segmentation_masks are returned as both float32 and int64.
steps: Build the Docker image with `bash setup_env.sh`.
Observe the tf.switch_case dtype mismatch inside keras_cv.layers.RandAugment.
